description: Fetch an account's followers, newest first, or with `type=following` the accounts it follows: each a profile with its follower and video counts, about 50 a page. Use this to see who an audience is, or who a creator watches. Give exactly one of `username` or `url`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

type.description: Who follows the account, or whom it follows.

username.description: The username. A leading @ is fine.

name: get_tiktok_followers
title: Get a TikTok account's followers or following
